stories.title: Clinical Trial Search Input/Output Schema
stories.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, radius, filters) and outputs (title, phase, summary, eligibility, locations, travel distance/time). Ensure strict contract compatibility with tool_router.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Core Logic
stories.description: Implement service logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov with recruiting filter, parse API responses, normalize fields, and extract trial metadata including eligibility and locations.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Time Enrichment
stories.description: Enhance trial results with travel distance and duration using Google Routes API, mapping user origin to trial site locations and appending structured travel data.

stories.title: Facade and Tool Router Integration
stories.description: Expose clinical trial search through EvaluateCare facade and register tool in tool_router with validated inputs, ensuring proper orchestration and response formatting for LLM tool use.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Tests and Integration
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering schema validation, API parsing, travel enrichment, and end-to-end invocation via facade and tool_router, following existing backend test patterns.
